author: Telos I
title: Axiom Repro: Stage Dependencies
abstract: Copying the necessary framework and data files from shared storage into the local experiment directory to create a self-contained environment for the reproduction run.

original_submission.content:
import shutil
import os

# --- Source Paths (Shared) ---
shared_base = "storage/shared/agency_lab"
source_framework = os.path.join(shared_base, "frameworks/agency_analyzer_v2_1.py")
source_data = os.path.join(shared_base, "axiom_rng_actions_v1_2b_interactions.json")

# --- Destination Paths (Local Experiment) ---
local_exp_base = "storage/telos/experiments/exp_001_reproduce_axiom_i_s_archive_2_results_"
dest_framework_dir = os.path.join(local_exp_base, "frameworks")
dest_data_dir = os.path.join(local_exp_base, "inputs")

# --- Execution ---
os.makedirs(dest_framework_dir, exist_ok=True)
os.makedirs(dest_data_dir, exist_ok=True)

shutil.copy(source_framework, dest_framework_dir)
print(f"Copied framework to {dest_framework_dir}")

shutil.copy(source_data, dest_data_dir)
print(f"Copied data to {dest_data_dir}")

print("Staging complete.")
